purpose: Conservative image-derived candidate support interiors for small supplemental people/facilities. No layout changes and no automatic broad terrain exemption.

coordinate_system.mapping_to_4096: multiply each x,y by 4096/1254 once; keep source visual annotation error separate

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 左侧上下平台连接的上半段斜坡内带。浅黄色路面连续，左下与右上均为棕色崖立面；多边形只取中间浅色沙路。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图可见同一斜坡，地表走势与clean一致。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 弯内侧靠近崖线，视觉边界误差约4px。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 左侧狭窄对角通路中段，从上方弯角向左下平台延伸。连续浅黄色表面，排除了右侧崖角和左侧石/灌木。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 用户标注左侧空通路；原图同段栏杆沿边缘而非横封路面。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 道路斜向，物件必须按实际脚底基座整体落入内带；误差约4px。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 左侧对角通路进入下平台的下部转角，只取浅色道路中线，避开东侧灌木。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图此处在酒馆/水塔之间的通路边，原有正式实例占地必须另行扣除。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 与建筑复原后的实际占地可能重叠，支撑合法不代表空位；误差约5px。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 桥面西中段：只取木板内部，避开西侧前景柱与中央前景柱，不包含桥梁侧面、横梁或柱脚。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图已有桥上角色，桥面确有可供小脚底支撑的木板宽度。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 必须使用桥面类别而非sand。窄带平均厚度约12–17px，视觉标注误差约3px；不得把角色脚底放到栏杆或桥侧立面。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 桥面东中段：木板内部，避开中央前景柱及桥右端柱。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图与clean的木板/栏杆边界一致。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 窄带约10–14px厚，仅适合小角色或小设施脚底。误差约3px；sprite身体可能跨栏杆投影，需另看图判断遮挡。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 桥右落地点及向东北接入上平台的浅色支路。桥柱右侧确有连续沙地；西北棕色块是崖壁，已排除。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图桥右角色与通路边栏杆提示落地处可步行；用户标注该落地点可补量。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 现有P034及其他来源锁点占地需要排除；误差约4px。桥端与地面高度切换不可用单个基座跨越。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 桥右落地点向东南下行的可见窄路；浅黄沙地连续，右上大崖立面及左下凸出高地均排除。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图该斜路边有栏杆与角色，沿相同浅色通路下行。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 需扣除正式来源栏杆完整标准件脚底；不得通过缩窄栏杆或挪原锚点腾空。误差约4px。

polygons_source_pixels.evidence_clean: 右侧窄路进入下平台的S弯内带，远离右侧崖角、左侧高地/石块与上端灌木。
polygons_source_pixels.evidence_original: 原图存在此通路及沿路边栏杆，clean保留相同地形。
polygons_source_pixels.uncertainty: 曲率较高，只放小脚底部件；不允许大设施跨越两个不同高度的可见表面。误差约5px。

use_constraints: These polygons identify visible support, not guaranteed unoccupied capacity. Subtract admitted frozen source bases and existing accepted supplemental bases before proposing.
Keep source identity, mirror and anchors unchanged. Polygons do not authorize relocation or removal of source instances.
A complete ground-contact footprint must fit the relevant terrain interior; an anchor point alone is insufficient. Respect visual annotation uncertainty and plugin contact geometry.
Bridge and sand are different height/support classes. Do not let a base straddle bridge deck and sand or the bridge side.
Do not include cliff faces, foreground bridge posts, railings, roof silhouettes or shrub occupancy to enlarge capacity.
Use intact standard PNGs, one final class size, normal horizontal mirror only. No clipping, stretching, component splitting or different per-instance scales.
This review did not run placement, renderer or geometric validation. Apply real plugin proposal/diagnostic/final validation and inspect the accepted full image.
Disjoint polygon segments are deliberate conservative interiors, not a claim of disconnected geography. The intervening transitions were left out to avoid post/edge uncertainty.

current_draft_proportion_review.observed: Buildings are substantially restored compared with R01 and no longer read as uniformly tiny toy houses; characters/facilities leave useful passage capacity. No oversized barrel/character issue was observed in this current draft.
current_draft_proportion_review.small_size_risk: At a fit-to-screen overview, barrel rings, crate diagonals and goose occupation accessories are fine details. Keep final 4096 crop visibility and intended viewing-scale recognizability separate; current small sizing is consistent with the requested direction, so this is a risk for final image review, not an instruction to enlarge them.
current_draft_proportion_review.large_size_risk: Larger source buildings may overlap nearby locked characters/facilities. Current diagnostic marks hidden items near northeast warehouse; count-complete final image must show actual pixel visibility and carrier relations rather than assuming occupied source anchors remain visible.
